_comment: Single source of truth for the built-in wrap-selection symbol catalogue, shared by the AHK tray menu (lib/wrap_symbols_config.ahk) and the macOS menubar (modules/shortcuts/actions/text.lua). Do NOT hardcode this list or its order in driver code — edit it here only.
_comment_format: 'groups' is an ordered array of groups; each group is an array of {left, right} pairs. The menu renders a separator (--) between consecutive groups, preserving this order. 'left' is the opening character and the canonical key for the per-symbol enabled/disabled state; 'right' is the closing character (equal to 'left' for symmetric symbols). Asymmetric pairs register both characters so typing either one wraps the selection.
